# AI 获客 (AI Customer Acquisition)

> An open-source, continuously updated book on customer acquisition in the age of AI search and agents: GEO / answer engines, the dark funnel, buyer agents and platform dependency.
> 一本免费公开、持续更新的开源书：AI 搜索与 Agent 时代的客户获取——GEO 与答案层、暗漏斗、买方代理权与平台依赖。

Key thesis: 获客不是企业发出的动作集合，而是企业获得进入买方决策过程资格的过程。
(Customer acquisition is not a set of actions a company emits; it is the process of earning a place inside the buyer's decision process.)

## Links

- Read online (Chinese): https://ai-customer-acquisition.fly2ai.top
- GitHub: https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book
- PDF (latest): https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book/raw/main/book/ai-customer-acquisition.pdf

- [第 1 章 买家换了入口：从结果页到答案层](https://ai-customer-acquisition.fly2ai.top/01-第1章-买家换了入口/) — 三次折叠；零点击的斜率；入口审计四步法
- [第 2 章 决策在暗漏斗里完成](https://ai-customer-acquisition.fly2ai.top/02-第2章-决策在暗漏斗里完成/) — 看不见的那段决策，第一次留下日志
- [第 3 章 你不在场时的那份名单：候选集机制](https://ai-customer-acquisition.fly2ai.top/03-第3章-候选集机制/) — 候选集是分布不是名单；稳定率才是资产

## Source discipline 来源纪律

每条数据标注性质：【官方口径】/【第三方验证】/【厂商宣称】/【本书判断】/【本书实测】。核不到原始发布方的数字不写入正文。自建实测公开方法与原始数据。
